scope: v6 changed native/preprocessing C++ cross-build, with unchanged verified v5 SDK reused; no ROS cross-build or board execution
elapsed_note: Time since completed cross-build log last modified; not build duration.

dependency_resolution_scope: Only the specified SDK installation and existing AArch64 sysroot. This does not verify board libraries.
runtime_compatibility_note: AArch64 architecture alone is insufficient. Board glibc, libstdc++, C++ ABI, Horizon runtime and other SONAME providers must match the build sysroot and satisfy all recorded version requirements. Board compatibility has not been tested.

camera_sdk._help: auto：新 Stereo 读取左右图用模式 1；原 Q8.8 用模式 2。camera 模式自动读取相机 SDK 的矫正后内参，使用与本帧匹配的参数，无需手填内参文件；本项目 ROS 相机发布节点的 CameraInfo 也来自 SDK。offline/recording 点云须另在相应输入配置显式指定 intrinsics_file，路径相对主 pipeline.json。

additional_runtime_requirements_outside_.camera_note: The camera SDK is loaded with dlopen and is not enumerated in these executables DT_NEEDED. Its configured library/vendor config and compatible dependencies must exist on the board.
additional_runtime_requirements_outside_.model_note: v6 crop inference has not been executed on X5. v5 board metadata identifies NV12 inputs and float32 output; model/runtime version warning remains independent of ELF architecture.

sdk_reuse: Unchanged SDK backend reused from validated v5 ARM installation; core/features SDK source diff and library SHA256 recorded in local_env/cpp_v6/logs.
